params.name: ip
params.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address. Accepts standard IP notation and also CIDR notation

params.name: reverse-lookup
params.description: Do a reverse DNS (PTR) lookup. This option can add extra delay to the request so only use it if you need it

items.docs: Get location information about an IP address and do reverse DNS (PTR) lookups

params.name: latitude
params.description: The location latitude in decimal degrees format

params.name: longitude
params.description: The location longitude in decimal degrees format

params.name: language-code
params.description:
The language to display results in, available languages are:
  • ar, de, en, es, fr, it, ja, nl, pt, ru, zh

params.name: zoom
params.description:
The zoom level to respond with:
  • address - the most precise address available
  • street - the street level
  • city - the city level
  • state - the state level
  • country - the country level

params.name: geohash
params.description: Reverse lookup by a geohash instead of using latitude and longitude

items.docs: Convert a geographic coordinate (latitude and longitude) into a real world address

params.name: address
params.description: The full address, partial address or name of a place to try and locate. Comma separated address components are preferred.

params.name: house-number
params.description: The house/building number to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: street
params.description: The street/road name to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: city
params.description: The city/town name to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: county
params.description: The county/region name to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: state
params.description: The state name to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: postal-code
params.description: The postal code to locate (for structured address searches)

params.name: country-code
params.description: Prefer results from this country code (the default is no country bias)

params.name: country-codes
params.description: Prefer results from this list of country codes (space or comma separated values). Preference is in the order supplied, you can use the 'country-code' parameter to also set a dynamic or user supplied country code which takes precedence

params.name: language-code
params.description:
The language to display results in, available languages are:
  • ar, de, en, es, fr, it, ja, nl, pt, ru, zh

params.name: auto-complete
params.description: Enable auto-complete for search-as-you-type and search suggestions. This option can find addresses based on partial search terms, combine with 'country-code' for country specific searches. Auto-complete works best with 'fuzzy-search' disabled for the fastest response times but can be combined if required

params.name: fuzzy-search
params.description: If no matches are found for the given address, start performing a recursive fuzzy search until a geolocation is found. This option is useful for processing user supplied input that may be incomplete or have typos and where you do not mind some potential loss in precision

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit search results to this many locations (between 1 and a maximum of 32)

items.docs: Geocode an address, partial address or just the name of a place
